recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, square vintage photograph of a man in formal attire sitting in a wicker chair, framed by a solid black border with bold blue block text at the top and elegant white script at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the central warm-toned photo and the stark black void
Juxtaposition of heavy industrial sans-serif and delicate formal script
Symmetrical vertical alignment of all elements along the center axis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is contained within a central square occupying approximately 50% of the total canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central photograph acts as the primary anchor, supported by the heavy blue title above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Vertical descent from the bold blue title, through the central portrait, to the script text at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central content, creating a 'frame' effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for high-contrast isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm sepia and tan tones within the central photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant medium-blue for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white/blue text and black background; low saturation in the vintage photo.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended heavy sans-serif and formal copperplate script.
letterConstructionRules: Upper text must be all-caps, ultra-bold, and horizontally extended.
Lower text must be title-case, slanted script with high stroke contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard font characteristics.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast pairing: industrial geometric sans-serif with traditional formal script.

avoid: Serif fonts for the top title
Modern minimalist sans for the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and horizontal stretch of the top title.
Matches the formal, high-contrast script of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square vintage 1970s-style photograph of a man with a mustache in a tuxedo sitting in a large wicker peacock chair, holding a pen and paper. Place this square image in the center of a solid black 1:1 canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, extended blue sans-serif title at the top. Add a medium-sized white formal script subtitle at the bottom. Ensure all text is perfectly centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the top text blue and the bottom text white?
Is the central photo a perfect square?
Are the fonts contrasting in style (heavy vs. script)?

mustRedesign: Parental Advisory logo must be removed or replaced with generic placeholder
Specific facial features of the subject to avoid likeness issues

mustAchieve: Authentic 70s film grain in the photo

postGenerationChecks: Check for horizontal centering of all elements
Verify the blue color is vibrant and not muted
Ensure the script text is legible against the black
Confirm the vintage photo has a warm, aged color grade
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black square canvas + centered vintage square photo + bold extended sans-serif header (Blue) + formal script footer (White).
